name: cdm/product/asset/ReferencePoolItem
description: This type contains all the constituent weight and reference information.

cashSettlementTermsReference.description: Reference to the cash settlement terms applicable to this item.

constituentWeight.description: Describes the weight of each of the constituents within the basket. If not provided, it is assumed to be equal weighted.

physicalSettlementTermsReference.description: Reference to the physical settlement terms applicable to this item.

protectionTermsReference.description: Reference to the documentation terms applicable to this item.
